name: Jazan
best_time_to_visit: Winter: December to February (Festivals) / Summer: June to August (Islands)
short_description: A southern gem where turquoise islands meet misty green mountains.
full_description: Jazan is famous for its stunning Red Sea coastline, the enchanting Farasan Islands, and the lush green heights of Jabal Fifa. It offers unique experiences from scuba diving in coral reefs to exploring ancient forts.

shopping.name: Kadi Mall
shopping.experience_summary: One of the largest malls in Jazan, featuring a mix of international and local brands.
shopping.top_activity: Shopping for traditional Jazan jasmine crowns (Fula) outside the mall
shopping.local_tip: The Pearl is great for families; ask for the catch of the day.

shopping.name: Al-Rashed Mall (Jazan)
shopping.experience_summary: A popular shopping destination with many entertainment options and cafes.
shopping.top_activity: Catching up with friends in the coffee lounge
shopping.local_tip: Perfect place to escape the afternoon heat and enjoy some shopping.

nature_and_adventure.name: Farasan Islands Reserve
nature_and_adventure.experience_summary: An archipelago of over 170 islands known for white sands and coral reefs.
nature_and_adventure.budget: $$ (Ferry is free, but boat rentals vary)
nature_and_adventure.top_activity: Snorkeling in the crystal clear turquoise waters
nature_and_adventure.local_tip: Book your free ferry ticket from the Jazan Port 24 hours in advance.

nature_and_adventure.name: Jabal Fifa (The Neighbors of the Moon)
nature_and_adventure.experience_summary: Lush green mountains with ancient terraces carved into the steep slopes.
nature_and_adventure.top_activity: Taking photos of the cylindrical heritage houses
nature_and_adventure.local_tip: Hire a local driver with a 4x4; the roads are extremely steep and curvy.

nature_and_adventure.name: Jazan Corniche
nature_and_adventure.experience_summary: A beautiful coastal stretch with parks, playgrounds, and sea views.
nature_and_adventure.signature_dish: Mifa Fish (Roasted in a traditional clay oven)
nature_and_adventure.top_activity: Watching the sunset over the Red Sea
nature_and_adventure.local_tip: Try the 'Mifa' fish at local spots for the most authentic Jazan taste.

heritage_and_landmarks.name: Jazan Heritage Village
heritage_and_landmarks.experience_summary: A living museum showcasing the diverse architecture and culture of Jazan.
heritage_and_landmarks.top_activity: Watch folk dances and local craft-making
heritage_and_landmarks.local_tip: Visit during the winter season to catch the Jazan Winter Festival events.

heritage_and_landmarks.name: Dosariya Fort
heritage_and_landmarks.experience_summary: A historical military fort built on a hill overlooking the city and sea.
heritage_and_landmarks.top_activity: Explore the old watchtowers and city views
heritage_and_landmarks.local_tip: The fort offers a great 360-degree view of the city—perfect for panoramic photos.

travel_tips: Plan your Farasan Islands trip by checking the ferry schedule online in advance.
Jabal Fifa has steep roads; hire a local guide if you're not used to mountain driving.
Try the 'Marsah' with honey—it’s the most famous local dish after seafood.
Jazan is famous for its Jasmine (Fula); buy a crown from local street vendors for the scent.
